definitions.rank_range: max minus min within-model percentile across the three families on the fixed full complete-case collection
definitions.centered_range: log2 range after model-wise cohort median removal; prediction diagnostic, not calibrated MIC
definitions.local_reference: exact expected score distance to another sequence matched on source and length, symmetric across anchors
definitions.component_subsets: deterministic two-way split for sensitivity after exploration; not independent confirmation

scope: Exploratory sequence/prediction associations; no measured activity, causal edit effects, or population significance inferred.
